people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Ben-ammi
people.line: Son of Lot's younger daughter; father of the Ammonites.

people.name: daughter2_of_Lot
people.line: Younger daughter of Lot; mother of Ben-ammi

translations.web: The younger also bore a son, and called his name Ben Ammi. He is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.
translations.bsb: The younger daughter also gave birth to a son, and she named him Ben-ammi. He is the father of the Ammonites of today.
translations.kjv: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Benammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.
translations.asv: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Ben-ammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.
